call_purpose: You wanted help with a coupon that was not applying at checkout, a wrong company name on your invoice, and extending the coupon's expiry date.

resolved.text: We guided you to assign your coupon to the Advanced Course, and you confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.

covered.text: We explained that you can extend the coupon's expiry date yourself in the coupon settings, where the date option is available.

customer_next_steps.text: Extend the coupon's expiry date in the coupon settings.
customer_next_steps.timeline: that night, the night of the call

support_next_steps.text: We will check the wrong company name in the GST part of your invoice and let you know.
support_next_steps.timeline: by the day after the call
